# τ sweep analysis figure: PPL and b* mean vs temperature parameter τ
# Generates dual-axis plot for paper Experiments section

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# --- Data ---
tau =      [0.50,   0.60,   0.70,   0.80,   0.90,   0.95]
ppl =      [17.688, 17.681, 17.679, 17.653, 17.712, 17.723]
bstar =    [0.39,   0.59,   0.89,   1.40,   2.36,   3.08]
uniform_ppl = 17.694

# --- Style ---
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['Times New Roman', 'DejaVu Serif'],
    'mathtext.fontset': 'stix',
    'axes.linewidth': 0.8,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.8,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.8,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
})

fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 3.5))

# --- Background shading ---
ax1.axvspan(0.48, 0.80, alpha=0.10, color='#2ca02c', zorder=0, label='Safe zone')
ax1.axvspan(0.80, 0.97, alpha=0.10, color='#d62728', zorder=0, label='Degradation zone')

# --- Left axis: PPL ---
color_ppl = '#1f77b4'
ln1 = ax1.plot(tau, ppl, 'o-', color=color_ppl, linewidth=1.8, markersize=6,
               markerfacecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.5, markeredgecolor=color_ppl,
               label='PPL (holdout)', zorder=3)
ax1.set_xlabel(r'Temperature $\tau$')
ax1.set_ylabel('Perplexity (PPL)', color=color_ppl)
ax1.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor=color_ppl)

# Uniform baseline
ax1.axhline(y=uniform_ppl, color='#7f7f7f', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.0, zorder=2)
ax1.annotate('Uniform', xy=(0.51, uniform_ppl), xytext=(0.51, uniform_ppl + 0.008),
             fontsize=9, color='#7f7f7f', ha='left', va='bottom')

# PPL y-axis range
ax1.set_ylim(17.640, 17.740)
ax1.set_xlim(0.48, 0.97)

# --- Right axis: b* mean ---
ax2 = ax1.twinx()
color_bstar = '#d62728'
ln2 = ax2.plot(tau, bstar, '^--', color=color_bstar, linewidth=1.8, markersize=7,
               markerfacecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.5, markeredgecolor=color_bstar,
               label=r'$b^*$ mean', zorder=3)
ax2.set_ylabel(r'$b^*$ mean', color=color_bstar)
ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor=color_bstar)

# --- Annotate τ=0.8 ---
idx_default = tau.index(0.80)
ax1.annotate(r'default ($\tau\!=\!0.8$)',
             xy=(0.80, ppl[idx_default]),
             xytext=(0.68, 17.730),
             fontsize=9,
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#333333', lw=1.0),
             color='#333333', ha='center', va='bottom', zorder=4)
ax1.axvline(x=0.80, color='#aaaaaa', linestyle=':', linewidth=0.8, zorder=1)

# --- Zone labels ---
ax1.text(0.64, 17.643, 'Safe zone', fontsize=8, color='#2ca02c', ha='center',
         fontstyle='italic', alpha=0.8)
ax1.text(0.885, 17.643, 'Degradation', fontsize=8, color='#d62728', ha='center',
         fontstyle='italic', alpha=0.8)

# --- Combined legend ---
lns = ln1 + ln2
labs = [l.get_label() for l in lns]
ax1.legend(lns, labs, loc='upper left', framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#cccccc')

# --- X ticks ---
ax1.set_xticks(tau)

# --- Save ---
out_base = '/root/provenance_weight_training/output/figures/tau_sweep_analysis'
fig.savefig(out_base + '.pdf', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=300)
fig.savefig(out_base + '.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=300)
plt.close()
print('Saved:', out_base + '.pdf')
print('Saved:', out_base + '.png')
PYEOF
